operators.name: group_norm_forward

parameters.name: input
parameters.shape: [N, C, H, W] with C divisible by num_groups

semantics: Computes GroupNorm: for each sample n and group g, mean and variance over channels in group and spatial dims H,W; normalizes (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps); then applies affine weight and bias per channel.
Input tensor may be non-contiguous; must handle arbitrary strides or make contiguous internally while preserving shape and dtype.
Weight and bias are 1D tensors of length C, applied to corresponding channels.
num_groups divides C; each group has group_channels = C / num_groups.
Output has same shape, dtype, and device as input.
Calls nn.GroupNorm(num_groups=3, num_channels=3, eps=1e-05, affine=True, bias=True).
Output shape [512,3,384,384], float32, CUDA, same strides as input (contiguous).
